profile.headline: IT Researcher, Developer of Hardware and Software
profile.summary:
I am not skilled at talking myself up, or giving myself credit for things I've done.  I just want to make things better, and make myself better every day.

Application Developer, Network and Systems Administrator, IoT Hardware Developer.

Specialties: 27 years of Windows Server support experience.  27 years of Windows desktop support experience.  18 years of custom development experience.  An entire career of problem solving experience and lessons learned.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Skills: GitHub Enterprise · PostgreSQL · Linux · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · Hyper-V · Go

positions.title: IT Research Analyst
positions.description: So much stuff.  Currently working with: Unity and Unreal game engines for the purposes of CAD data visualization, writing software in Go, C#, and Java to convert some of our CAD data into glTF for use in said engines.  Have also designed and built outdoor sensor platforms for animal and field monitoring for farm use.  So much stuff.  This is the best job ever.

positions.title: IT Architect
positions.description:
* Architected & implemented a virtualization infrastructure based on Hyper-V and VMware, followed by a migration of Hyper-V guests to VMware, all connected to an iSCSI SAN.  Led a team of two in all day-to-day IT operations and implementations. 
* Upgraded iSCSI SAN to larger disk, migrating all data, file security, and virtual machines to the larger drives, after configuration of new LUNs & iSCSI targets.
* Deployed new SharePoint, Exchange, Active Directory, File Server, Lync, and various Linux virtual machines, completely replacing and re-architecting the entire corporate infrastructure in the process, resulting in a much cleaner infrastructure which provided the services requested by various organizational units within the company.
* Transitioned over a dozen physical servers to virtual servers, except in cases where physical servers were required.
* Selected and deployed an entirely new switching architecture based on HP ProCurve switches, replacing the existing Linksys infrastructure in the process.
* Deployed a Systems Center Configuration Manager server for software deployment and enterprise system management.
* Consistently evaluated corporate infrastructure and continually proposed improvements to the architecture and its components when required to create and maintain an enterprise-class infrastructure.
* Created, monitored, enforced, and adapted IT policies for 150 users.
* Provided technical assistance to end users, documenting frequently encountered issues and publishing them in the ticketing system for use by the entire IT team.
* Performed on-call duties when needed.
* Maintained and greatly expanded the local Asterisk server, changing voice carriers twice, and expanding the number of phones by a factor of 10 during my tenure.
* Expanded corporate infrastructure design to accommodate a second office, and worked closely with the corporate offices in India to unify the corporate network globally.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Co-developed and co-maintained J2EE codebases for liasophia.com and pamperedchef.com.
* Used Eclipse to find bugs and implement, test, and deploy hundreds of customer requested changes in a timely manner, while documenting changes in source code and in progress reports to supervisors, satisfying the customers’ needs for daily updates on development progression and providing a verifiable history, reasoning, and the work efforts of changes in the source files themselves.
* Administered & troubleshot JBoss server instances in development and production environments
* Performed on-call duties for both sites, when automation spotted outages or service degradation.

positions.title: Support Analyst
positions.description:
* System Administrator for Solaris, Windows, AIX, Linux and the product I supported: Voyager.
* Database Administration for Oracle. 
* Software administration for several Ex Libris products.
Contract position; left when contract expired.

positions.title: Systems Analyst - Object Oriented
positions.description: J2EE, J2SE, and WebSphere development mentor for developers within State Farm Insurance.  Performed both formal and informal code reviews for various projects internal to the organization.

positions.title: Technical Analyst
positions.description: Java developer, HP Service Desk administrator.  Wrote custom software to bi-directionally integrate Microsoft Operations Manager and HP Service Desk.  Visualized data collected by HP Service Desk using Java, XML, Google Maps, and Google Earth.  Wrote and maintained various utility programs in Java, Perl, and C#.

positions.title: Technical Yahoo!
positions.description:
Desktop support, Operations Engineer, datacenter manager.
* Led management on the Yahoo! AUNZ datacenter in Sydney.
* Organized migration of the datacenter infrastructure twice, once due to our provider (Intel) relocating, once when we switched service providers to Telstra, each move resulting in zero downtime of the site.
* Led the ongoing duty to support all servers, and was responsible for their day-to-day health.
* Worked with one other to support approximately 85 users in the corporate office, including their desktop and laptop computers, office servers, network switches, and associated infrastructure.
* Worked with many to support the local Yahoo! website, through system administration and Perl scripting of all sorts.
* Worked with global Network Operations Center (NOC) to maintain uptime and service availability.
* Worked with a great team on the development and maintenance of backoffice apps, such as asset management and request tracking.
